query:
UPDATE comptes.personne
        SET nom                = $2,
            prenoms            = $3,
            telephone          = $4,
            email              = $5,
            type_piece         = $6,
            numero_piece       = $7,
            piece_capturee_le  = CASE WHEN $7::TEXT IS NULL THEN piece_capturee_le ELSE $8 END,
            nom_repli          = $9,
            telephone_repli    = $10,
            numero_piece_repli = $11,
            horodatage_client  = $12,
            modifie_le         = now()
        WHERE id = $1
        RETURNING id
